summary: FedEx Corp filed an 8-K announcing cash tender offers to purchase up to $4.15B aggregate principal of 19 series of outstanding senior notes. Holders tendering by July 9, 2026 receive total consideration including an early tender premium of $30 per $1,000 principal. The offers expire July 24, 2026, unless extended. This is a debt buyback to reduce leverage/interest expense, refinance or return capital. No board recommendation or advisor named. Settlement expected promptly after acceptance. What to watch: acceptance proration if oversubscribed, and subsequent new issuance or free cash flow impact.
